name: upres-cli
description: UpRes MCP server: list the 14 public aliases, query credits, and submit image, video, and speech jobs via the UpRes API.
long_description: UpRes MCP server: list the 14 public aliases, query credits, and submit image, video, and speech jobs via the UpRes API. Tools: upres_list_models, upres_get_credits, upres_upscale_image, upres_upscale_video, upres_enhance_audio, upres_get_job.

api_key.title: UpRes API key
api_key.description: UpRes API key from https://upres.ai/account — required for upscale and credit tools.

tools.name: upres_list_models
tools.description: List the 14 public UpRes aliases for image, video, and speech.

tools.name: upres_get_credits
tools.description: Show recent job count for the authenticated UpRes API key as a quota proxy.

tools.name: upres_upscale_image
tools.description: Submit an image job from a public URL. Aliases: flare, prism, lumen, mirage, hush, keen, visage, atelier.

tools.name: upres_upscale_video
tools.description: Submit a video job from a public URL. Aliases: motion, motion-x, still, cadence, atelier-x.

tools.name: upres_enhance_audio
tools.description: Submit a speech job from a public audio URL. Alias: voice. Not for music.

tools.name: upres_get_job
tools.description: Get status and result_url of an UpRes job by id.
